I know he's only been out for a day but does anyone have any first impressions? I played a few games against him and while his W is pretty strong, it is pretty well balanced against his three hit mechanic. The only annoying factor is how he can essentially keep a permanent three stacks on you. A suggestion could be to lose 1 stack every time he uses an 3-stack ability so that he has to keep on auto-ing, giving people counterplay like flashing away and not getting stunned by the short q cooldown right away.

I'm not sure if I've played against a decent TK yet, he typically did pretty alright early game but seemed to fall off mid-late game possibly because the person didn't have the farm or knowledge on how to build. I do agree that he can keep 3 stacks on you permanently and that is a little odd.

As people get better with him games will get more interesting, his release along with item reworks might be behind this.

I agree with what's been said, the 3 stacks thing is just... weird. Seems out of place, like they forgot to put a timelimit on it.

Other than that, i think his grey health is gonna a very unhealthy part of his kit when people learn to use it. it gives him so much free tankyness, aswell as being something near a guarantee that he'll win trades much more than he should.

My biggest problems with it is that it requiers no skill at all. you dont have to do anything to regen A LOT of health, and only press a button to get an instant shield that can potentially be around 80% of your HP if you get bursted.

All that would be ok, if it had some counterplay. but the enemy can literally do nothing, except take something with Grievous Wound to reduce his healing. And that either requires you to take ignite to counter a low-cooldown ability, or to buy an item with applies Grievous Wound, and that still leaves him with this extreme heal in the early game before big items come out.

And even then, he can choose to shield himself instead, and your itemization against his healing will be worth very little.
